content: Chrome displays tiny JPEGs differently because it decodes small images at reduced resolution for performance, then upscales them. This causes visible artifacts compared to other browsers that render at full resolution. The behavior stems from Skia's image decoding optimization, which thresholds based on pixel count rather than dimensions.

content: Guo Lanying, renowned Chinese opera singer and "People's Artist," died in Guangzhou on August 11, 2026, at age 97. Born into poverty in 1930, she joined a theater troupe at age four and later the revolution, becoming celebrated for pioneering the integration of traditional opera into new national opera. Her iconic performances included "My Motherland," "Nanniwan," and roles in *The White-Haired Girl* and *The Marriage of Xiao Erhei*. Her voice became a collective national memory across generations.

Google Research and DeepMind developed AMIE (Video), an AI system using Gemini and Project Astra that conducts real-time clinical video consultations. It employs three parallel agents for conversation, clinical reasoning, and audio-visual perception. In a randomized study with 300 simulated consultations against primary care physicians, AMIE (Video) achieved expert-level performance in diagnostic accuracy, history-taking, and management, while excelling at physical observation and examination guidance. Patient actors preferred video over text interfaces. The study was limited to simulated settings with trained actors; real-world validation with actual patients remains essential before clinical deployment.

title: From coder to orchestrator: How agents shift the role of a developer
content: AI agents are shifting developers from coders to system orchestrators. Reliable software delivery requires structured workflows with triggers, automated checks, and human oversight—not single prompts. GitHub Copilot enables this through event-driven automations, CLI integration in Actions, and MCP extensions. Effective agent workflows combine flexible AI handling of complex tasks with deterministic boundaries: CI checks, branch protections, and required reviews. Developers should start small with bounded workflows like issue triage or documentation updates, then expand their orchestration role across the delivery pipeline.

title: 我做了一个让 Agent 更安全地接收密钥的 Skill
content: Loopmark is an open-source Agent Skill for securely receiving API tokens and secrets without exposing plaintext in chat contexts. The workflow: the agent generates a form link; users fill it in their browser; non-sensitive answers are copied back, while secrets are encrypted locally and never appear in copied content. The agent downloads and decrypts secrets to a temporary local .env file. Cloud stores only ciphertext; decryption keys remain solely on the agent's device. Uses hybrid encryption with session-derived symmetric keys and ECDH-AES-GCM for secret fields. Deployable via managed service or self-hosted on Cloudflare.
